title: AiryWeight Eucalyptus Sheet Set
description:
Experience supreme softness and incomparable natural coolness with our luxurious eucalyptus sheets. When it comes to staying cool, sleek, and light, our eucalyptus bed sheets are unmatched. These sheets are designed with the most sensitive sleepers in mind, offering a blend of hypoallergenic protection, moisture-wicking performance, and a silky-soft feel that stays comfortable night after night.

Features: 

  • Asthma and Allergy Friendly, Oeko-Tex Class 1 Certified: Naturally hypoallergenic, free from bleach and dyes, safe for sensitive skin.
  • Cool to the Touch & Moisture-Wicking: Absorbs 70% more moisture than cotton, ensuring a dry and comfortable sleep.
  • Silky Soft: Luxuriously smooth, soft like silk, and gentle on sensitive skin.
  • Light & Durable: Lightweight at 130 GSM, withstanding over 2,000 rubs without pilling in lab testing. 
  • 16” Deep Pocket: Fitted sheet designed to fit most mattresses, ensuring a secure fit.
  • Includes: 1 fitted sheet and 2 pillowcases (1 for Twin/Twin XL). Flat sheet optional. Choose your size With Flat Sheet or No Flat Sheet.
